purpose: Measure how a universal local log-radius smoothing scale separates observed galaxy and cluster baryonic profiles and how strongly it depends on the raw-lensing extrapolation cutoff.
claim_boundary: This is a descriptive baryonic-profile audit, not evidence that the slope coordinate causes gravity.
SPARC slopes use the same outer held-out rows available to the transfer test; they are not full resolved mass maps.
Raw-lensing profiles include the pipeline's interpolation and isolated outer tail, so cutoff sensitivity diagnoses the implemented formula rather than new astronomical information.
